tasks.title: Complete the database optimization and deploy the updated API version
Implement the task list UI and finish the API integration
Configure the CI/CD pipeline for automatic deployment to the staging server
Start testing the dashboard feature and prepare a detailed bug report
Prepare the API documentation and share it with the team
Finish the API endpoints for notifications and push the code to the repository
Add the notification panel in the dashboard
Design the notification component and integrate it with the backend API
Connect the email service to our staging environment
Test both the dashboard notifications and email alerts
Prepare the documentation for the notification API and upload it to the project repository
Add API documentation along with usage examples

transcripts.content:
Priya: Good morning everyone. Let's review the progress on the TaskFlow project. Our main goal this week is to complete the task dashboard feature.

Rohan: The backend APIs for task management are almost ready. I will complete the database optimization and deploy the updated API version by Wednesday.

Priya: Great. Sneha, once the APIs are ready, please connect them to the frontend dashboard so users can view and update tasks easily.

Sneha: Sure. I will implement the task list UI and finish the API integration by Friday.

Karan: I will also configure the CI/CD pipeline so that every new update is automatically deployed to the staging server.

Meera: After the deployment is ready, I will start testing the dashboard feature and prepare a detailed bug report.

Priya: Good plan. We also need documentation for the new APIs. Rohan, please prepare the API documentation and share it with the team by Thursday.

Rohan: No problem, I will upload the documentation to the project repository.

Priya: Perfect. Let’s try to finish these tasks before the next sprint review meeting.

Priya: Good morning everyone. Today we need to discuss progress on the notification system for the TaskFlow platform.

Rohan: I have already started working on the backend service for sending task reminders. I will finish the API endpoints for notifications and push the code to the repository by Thursday.

Priya: That sounds good. Sneha, once Rohan completes the API, please add the notification panel in the dashboard so users can see reminders for their tasks.

Sneha: Sure. I will design the notification component and integrate it with the backend API by Friday.

Karan: I will also configure the email notification service so that users receive reminders for upcoming deadlines.

Priya: Great. Please make sure the email service is connected to our staging environment before the end of the week.

Meera: After the notification feature is ready, I will test both the dashboard notifications and email alerts to make sure everything works properly.

Priya: Perfect. Also, we need documentation for the notification API. Rohan, please prepare the documentation and upload it to the project repository by Friday.

Rohan: Okay, I will add the API documentation along with usage examples.

Priya: Excellent. Let’s try to complete all these tasks before the next sprint review meeting.
